sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 24; Internal Quality Checks row 24; sheet list)
evidence: Static structural review of frozen .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/task/tests against workbook row 24 (Quality Checks + Internal Quality Checks annotation), skill references/quality-checks.md #24 and staged-task-contract.md, compared with the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests. (1) tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 (sum 1.0, all positive); [floors] functional=0.05 - byte-identical in content to template scoring.toml; every name maps to tests/gates/<name> or tests/scored/<name> directories, which exist. (2) All five judge.toml files parsed with tomllib: [judge] tables (judge='claude-code', mode='batched', isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md', timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900, mcp_servers) compare EQUAL to the template's [judge] tables; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys. Every file has playwright stdio MCP ('playwright-mcp --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox'); only scored/functional/judge.toml additionally declares name='verifier', command='/usr/local/bin/python3', args=['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py','$APP_RESTART_HELPER'] (judge.toml:18). tests/test.sh:193 'export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"' after heredoc generation, sed placeholder substitution and chmod 755 (test.sh:183-192), before run_suite gates/scored (test.sh:211,223). test.sh, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the template (diff clean). (3) [scoring] aggregation: gates 'all_pass', scored 'weighted_mean'. Criteria: render 1 (hro_gate_render binary 1.0), constraints 1 (hro_gate_shared binary 1.0) - gates binary; functional 43 binary, weights 0.5-2.5 all positive, ids unique; polish 5 binary (weights 3,3,2,1.5,2.5); visual 5 likert points=5 weight 1.2 each with 1-5 anchors in descriptions (e.g. hro_vis_type). No extra criterion keys; all descriptions non-empty. (4) Prompts resolve: each of the five prompt.md contains exactly one {app_context} and one {criteria} and no other brace placeholder; each line 1 opens http://localhost:3000; test.sh:196-201 substitutes {app_context} from /tests/app_context.md into /tests/*/*/prompt.md, so templated text resolves; app_context.md contains no braces. Functional prompt.md:1 and :51 direct the judge to restart_app once at the end (protocol D), no shell. (5) score.py:10 resolves POLICY as Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'scoring.toml' and reads gates/weights/floors (score.py:29-31), consistent with tools/ sitting one level under tests/. Adversarial: a broken app cannot exploit wiring (gates all_pass with binary zero-weight gates, floor on functional); a conforming app cannot be failed by wiring (restart helper exported, prompts resolve). Limitation: no configured RewardKit/judge run of this candidate exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope states full configured grading is absent), so runtime loading of these files is NOT EXERCISED; the [judge] blocks and criterion schema match the template exactly, and runtime/workload adequacy (43-criterion functional batch in 9000s) belongs to rows 11/workload records, not this structural row.
